data.one_liner: Flutter package providing Boxicons icon set with over 2K icons.
data.what_it_does: It exposes IconData constants for Boxicons, allowing developers to use the icon set in Flutter widgets. The package supports null safety and web, iOS, Android, macOS, windows, and linux platforms.
use_when: You need a large, free icon set for your app
You want to use Boxicons without adding the full web font
avoid_when: You already use another icon package that covers your needs
You need vector graphics or custom icon rendering
strengths: Easy to use via IconData constants
Supports all major Flutter platforms including web
weaknesses: No vector rendering or SVG support
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_boxicons to pubspec dependencies and import package:flutter_boxicons/flutter_boxicons.dart

alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a different icon set with similar usage pattern
